articles.title: Spain Lifts the Trophy, But the 2026 World Cup Leaves Big Questions
articles.summary: Spain defeated Argentina in a historic 48-team World Cup final. While the expanded format gave us Cinderella stories like Cape Verde, controversial hydration breaks and geopolitical tensions overshadowed parts of the tournament.

articles.title: Burnham's Bold Promises: Unfreezing Tax Thresholds and Ending Rough Sleeping, But at What Cost?
articles.summary: New UK PM Andy Burnham is considering unfreezing income tax thresholds, a move that could cost £4 billion and benefit middle-income workers. He also pledges to end rough sleeping and boost housebuilding, but faces tight borrowing rules and market scrutiny.

articles.title: Strait of Hormuz Tensions Send Shockwaves Through Global Oil Markets
articles.summary: US gas prices hit $4/gallon as the US-Iran ceasefire collapses, disrupting tanker traffic through the Strait of Hormuz. With Houthi rebels threatening a Red Sea blockade, oil prices are spiking and consumers are feeling the pinch.
